## Feature-group lift (`artifacts/evaluation/ablation_results.json`)
| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| DTL feature lift (PR-AUC) | +0.2302 (31.7% relative) |
| Graph feature lift (PR-AUC) | +0.0095 (1.0% relative) |
| Baseline-harness DTL lift (PR-AUC) | +0.1946 |
| Baseline-harness DTL lift vs per-rail silo | +0.2078 |

**These are the ONLY DTL lift figures, and they are NOT interchangeable.** Any other value in any document is stale.

- **Feature-group lift, +0.2302** — removes the DTL feature GROUPS from one model and retrains it. `ablation_results.json`, variant A minus variant B.
- **Baseline-harness lift, +0.1946** — compares two SEPARATELY TRAINED architectures on the all-families-seen condition. `baselines.json` → `measured_dtl_lift`.
- **Lift vs per-rail silo, +0.2078** — the hybrid against siloed per-rail models.

They differ because they are different experiments, not because one is wrong. Quote the one whose definition matches the sentence you are writing, and name which it is — publishing a single unqualified "DTL lift" is how this quantity ended up in the repository with four different values.
